title: A TreeList iterator survives a refused indexed edit
summary: A rejected indexed add or remove leaves the list unchanged. An iterator made before rejection should return the original first element.

change.description: A rejected indexed add or remove leaves the list unchanged. An iterator made before rejection should return the original first element.

notes: The independent JVM oracle covered 112 inputs on each revision. parent mismatches were 0 for exception, 0 for contents, 112 for existing, 0 for fresh. fix mismatches were 0 for exception, 0 for contents, 0 for existing, 0 for fresh.
